title: mut.feedback
mutation_directive: MAKE MORE INTENTFUL — the alphabet cage currently reads as arbitrary letter-sprites floating in Klein topology. Give it INTENT: (1) Choose a SEMANTIC DIRECTION — are the letters spelling something? Are they an alphabet as FORM (each letter a unique shape that contributes to the whole)? Are they constraints that guide the topology's self-organization? (2) The topology and typographic elements should have CAUSAL relationship — not just visual overlap. Example: the Klein-bottle structure dictates WHERE letters can exist and HOW they morph as they travel the surface. (3) STRENGTHEN THE FORM — make it read as a unified sculpture first, typographic detail second. Right now it feels like two ideas colliding without conversation.

threejs_review.directive: Replace sprites with InstancedMesh using THREE.ShaderMaterial to project letter glyphs onto the Klein surface as a texture-atlas, unifying topology and type. Letters become surface features rather than overlaid sprites, gaining proper lighting/depth and removing the billboard disconnect.
